# Generated Cmake Pico project file

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Initialise pico_sdk from installed location
# (note this can come from environment, CMake cache etc)

# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.0)
set(toolchainVersion 15_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.0)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()

# --- Web asset embedding (Windows + Linux) -----------------------------------

set(ASSETS_DIR     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/http)
set(GENERATED_DIR  ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated_http)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${GENERATED_DIR})

# Embedded web assets are generated by a small CMake script so the firmware
# build has no extra host-language dependency (Python/xxd/etc.).
set(EMBED_ASSET_SCRIPT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tools/embed_asset.cmake")

function(embed_asset SRC)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${SRC}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Asset file not found: ${SRC}")
    endif()

    get_filename_component(NAME "${SRC}" NAME)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "[^A-Za-z0-9_]" "_" SYMBOL "${NAME}")
    set(OUT "${GENERATED_DIR}/${SYMBOL}.c")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${OUT}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
                "-DINPUT=${SRC}"
                "-DOUTPUT=${OUT}"
                "-DSYMBOL=${SYMBOL}"
                -P "${EMBED_ASSET_SCRIPT}"
        DEPENDS "${SRC}" "${EMBED_ASSET_SCRIPT}"
        COMMENT "Embedding ${SRC} -> ${OUT}"
        VERBATIM
    )

    set(GENERATED_ASSETS ${GENERATED_ASSETS} "${OUT}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# Add assets here
embed_asset("${ASSETS_DIR}/index.html")
# embed_asset("${ASSETS_DIR}/app.js")
# embed_asset("${ASSETS_DIR}/style.css")

# Target that generates all web assets
add_custom_target(generate_web_assets DEPENDS ${GENERATED_ASSETS})



# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD pico2_w CACHE STRING "Board type")

# Select the locked SDK after the VS Code defaults, before SDK import/project.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/zap_sdk.cmake")

# Pull in Raspberry Pi Pico SDK (must be before project)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(Hub C CXX ASM)

set(HUB_FIRMWARE_VERSION "0.6.33")
set(HUB_GENERATED_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${HUB_GENERATED_DIR})
configure_file(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/firmware_version.h.in
    ${HUB_GENERATED_DIR}/firmware_version.h
    @ONLY
)

# Network credentials are local build settings, not source-code defaults.
set(HUB_WIFI_SSID "" CACHE STRING "Wi-Fi SSID used by the Hub reference application")
set(HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD "" CACHE STRING "Wi-Fi password used by the Hub reference application")

# Optional, git-ignored local credentials. Copy wifi.local.cmake.example to
# wifi.local.cmake and fill it in. Values set there take precedence.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/wifi.local.cmake OPTIONAL)

# Allow IDE/direct-CMake builds to use the same local environment variables
# as Zap. Explicit -D cache values still take precedence.
if(NOT HUB_WIFI_SSID AND DEFINED ENV{ZAP_HUB_WIFI_SSID})
    set(HUB_WIFI_SSID "$ENV{ZAP_HUB_WIFI_SSID}"
        CACHE STRING "Wi-Fi SSID used by the Hub reference application" FORCE)
endif()
if(NOT HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD AND DEFINED ENV{ZAP_HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD})
    set(HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD "$ENV{ZAP_HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD}"
        CACHE STRING "Wi-Fi password used by the Hub reference application" FORCE)
endif()
set(HUB_WIFI_SSID_C "${HUB_WIFI_SSID}")
set(HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD_C "${HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD}")
foreach(_wifi_var HUB_WIFI_SSID_C HUB_WIFI_PASSWORD_C)
    string(REPLACE "\\" "\\\\" ${_wifi_var} "${${_wifi_var}}")
    string(REPLACE "\"" "\\\"" ${_wifi_var} "${${_wifi_var}}")
endforeach()
configure_file(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/wifi_config.h.in
    ${HUB_GENERATED_DIR}/wifi_config.h
    @ONLY
)

# Initialise the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# Application-owned configuration, supplied through ZapEE's public option.
set(ZAPEE_PICO_NETWORK_CONFIG_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" CACHE PATH
    "Directory containing the application's lwipopts.h")

# Optional Zap helper integration. `zap.yml` is the friendly dependency manifest;
# cmake/zap_deps.cmake is generated from it and remains ordinary CMake so the
# helper is never mandatory for experienced users or CI systems.
# ZAP MANAGED DEPENDENCIES BEGIN
# Managed by zap. Zap may replace only text between this BEGIN/END pair.
# User CMake outside this block is never rewritten by zap.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/zap_deps.cmake")
# ZAP MANAGED DEPENDENCIES END

# Add executable. Firmware version is defined once above and exported to code.

add_executable(Hub
    Hub.c
    cooling.c
    pumping.c
    sensing.c
    sweeping.c
    ztmb/log.c
    ztmb/adc.c
    ztmb/ztm_psu_hv_adapter.c
    ztmb/ztm_pwm_adapter.c
    ztmb/ztm_adc_adapter.c
    ztmb/ztm_psu_tec_adapter.c
    ztmb/ztm_stepper_adapter.c
    ztmb/cli_wifi.c
    ztmb/cli_cmds.c
    ztmb/web_assets.c
    ztmb/modules.c
    ztmb/ztmb.c
    ${GENERATED_ASSETS}
)

pico_set_program_name(Hub "Hub")
pico_set_program_version(Hub "${HUB_FIRMWARE_VERSION}")

# The Pico SDK injects some SDK sources directly into the Hub target and
# those sources use GNU C extensions (for example the `asm` keyword). Keep
# the application target on GNU11 for Pico SDK compatibility. ZapEE itself
# remains strict ISO C11 (C_EXTENSIONS=NO) at the reusable-library boundary.
set_target_properties(Hub PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
    C_EXTENSIONS YES
)

# Modify the below lines to enable/disable output over UART/USB
pico_enable_stdio_uart(Hub 1)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(Hub 0)


# The network component needs this application's lwipopts.h.
set(_hub_missing_targets "")
foreach(_hub_target zap::pico_ztpico2 zap::pico_network
        zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_psu_tec zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_pwm zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_adc zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_stepper)
    if(NOT TARGET ${_hub_target})
        list(APPEND _hub_missing_targets ${_hub_target})
    endif()
endforeach()
if(_hub_missing_targets)
    if(NOT TARGET pico_cyw43_arch_lwip_threadsafe_background)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing targets: ${_hub_missing_targets}. Pico SDK at '${PICO_SDK_PATH}' has no CYW43/lwIP wireless support. Run zap sync --no-configure with Zap 0.11.0 or newer to initialize SDK submodules.")
    endif()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing ZapEE targets: ${_hub_missing_targets}. Check the ZapEE dependency path and selected components in zap.yml, then run zap sync --no-configure.")
endif()

target_link_libraries(Hub zap::pico_ztpico2 zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_psu_tec zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_pwm zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_adc zap::pico_ztpico2_ztm_stepper zap::registry zap::cli zap::pico_log zap::pico_network)

# Add the standard library to the build
target_link_libraries(Hub
        pico_stdlib
        pico_cyw43_arch_lwip_threadsafe_background
)

# Add the standard include files to the build
target_include_directories(Hub PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
        ${HUB_GENERATED_DIR}
)

# For sys_thread_new / netconn API you also need:
target_link_libraries(Hub
    pico_lwip
    pico_lwip_netif
)

# Add any user requested libraries
target_link_libraries(Hub
        hardware_spi
        hardware_i2c

        )

pico_add_extra_outputs(Hub)

target_compile_definitions(Hub PRIVATE
    PICO_DEFAULT_UART=0
    PICO_DEFAULT_UART_TX_PIN=16
    PICO_DEFAULT_UART_RX_PIN=17
    PICO_STDIO_UART_TX_BUFFER_SIZE=4096

    PICO_CYW43_ARCH_DEBUG_ENABLED=0
    CYW43_ENABLE_DEBUG=0
    #CYW43_DEBUG=0
    #CYW43_VERBOSE_DEBUG=0
    LWIP_DEBUG=0
)

# ZAP MANAGED TARGETS BEGIN
# Managed by zap. Zap may replace only text between this BEGIN/END pair.
# User CMake outside this block is never rewritten by zap.
if(COMMAND zap_apply_dependencies)
    zap_apply_dependencies(Hub)
endif()
# ZAP MANAGED TARGETS END
